brief:
Israeli authorities have placed an exit ban on Shawan Jabarin, executive director of the Palestinian human rights organization Al-Haq, according to DAWN. The ban prevents the internationally recognized human rights defender from traveling outside the country.

DAWN issued a statement on November 13 in response to the measure, which restricts the movement of one of the region's most prominent advocates for accountability and documentation of alleged violations.
dek: (Washington, D.C., November 13, 2026) – In response to Israeli authorities placing an exit ban on globally renowned human rights defender and executive director of Al-Haq, Shawan Jabarin, DAWN issues the following statement…
title: Israel bars human rights defender Shawan Jabarin from leaving country
